name: input-unicode
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none  @root @mapping(Value, params=[first,again]) Root ::= CAPTURE(word, ('😀' | 'x')) @first ':' SAME_AS(word) @again;  }

name: grapheme-codepoints
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none  @root @mapping(Value, params=[first,again]) Root ::= CAPTURE(word, ('👩‍👩‍👧‍👦' | 'é')) @first ':' SAME_AS(word) @again;  }

name: forward-unbound
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none  @root @mapping(Value) Root ::= SAME_AS(word) CAPTURE(word,'x');  }

name: discarded-alternative
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none  @root @mapping(Value) Root ::= (CAPTURE(word,'x') 'z' | 'x') SAME_AS(word);  }

name: shadow
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none  @root @mapping(Value) Root ::= CAPTURE(word,'a') CAPTURE(word,'b') SAME_AS(word);  }

name: scope-shadow
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none  @root @mapping(Value) Root ::= CAPTURE(word,'a') CAPTURE_SCOPE(CAPTURE(word,'b') SAME_AS(word)) SAME_AS(word);  }

name: scope-expiry
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none  @root @mapping(Value) Root ::= CAPTURE_SCOPE(CAPTURE(word,'a')) SAME_AS(word);  }

name: scope-local
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none  @root @mapping(Value) Root ::= CAPTURE_SCOPE(CAPTURE(word,'a') SAME_AS(word));  }

name: empty-owned
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none token E=EOF @root @mapping(Value) Root ::= CAPTURE(word,E{0}) SAME_AS(word);  }

name: empty-replay-repeat
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none token E=EOF @root @mapping(Value, params=[values]) Root ::= CAPTURE(word,E{0}) SAME_AS(word)* @values 'x';  }

name: empty-replay-separation
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none token E=EOF @root @mapping(Value, params=[values]) Root ::= CAPTURE(word,E{0}) SAME_AS(word) % SAME_AS(word) @values 'x';  }

name: retry-memo
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none  @root @mapping(Value) Root ::= (Captured 'z' | Captured 'y') SAME_AS(word); Captured ::= CAPTURE(word,'x'); }

name: lexical-store-isolation
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none @ubnf: v2 token T ::= CAPTURE(word,'a') SAME_AS(word); @root @mapping(Value) Root ::= CAPTURE(word,'b') T SAME_AS(word);  }

name: ast-capture-store-isolation
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none  @root @mapping(Value, params=[word,again]) Root ::= CAPTURE(word,'a') @word CAPTURE(word,'b') SAME_AS(word) @again;  }

name: optional-field-inside
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none  @root @mapping(Value, params=[first,again]) Root ::= CAPTURE(word,['a' @first]) SAME_AS(word) @again;  }

name: list-field-inside
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none  @root @mapping(Value, params=[parts,again]) Root ::= CAPTURE(word,{'a' @parts}) ':' SAME_AS(word) @again;  }

name: legacy-identifier-group
grammar:
grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none  @root @mapping(Value) Root ::= CAPTURE ('x') SAME_AS // comment
('x') CAPTURE_SCOPE ('x') CAPTURE_MORE ('x'); CAPTURE ::= 'c'; SAME_AS ::= 's'; CAPTURE_SCOPE ::= 'g'; CAPTURE_MORE ::= 'l'; }

name: generated-actual-text
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none @tokenAdapter: { id: 'owned.generated' version: '1' java: 'org.unlaxer.dsl.codegen.OwnedGeneratedTokenParser' rust: 'crate::generated_token' } token T = ADAPTER('owned.generated', version=1) @root @mapping(Value, params=[again]) Root ::= CAPTURE(word,T) SAME_AS(word) @again;  }

name: projected-actual-text
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none @tokenAdapter: { id: 'owned.projected' version: '1' java: 'org.unlaxer.dsl.codegen.OwnedProjectedTokenParser' rust: 'crate::projected_token' } token T = ADAPTER('owned.projected', version=1) @root @mapping(Value, params=[again]) Root ::= CAPTURE(word,T) SAME_AS(word) @again;  }

name: resource-owned-recursion
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none @root @mapping(Value) Root ::= CAPTURE(word, ('x' Root | 'a')); }

name: mapped-child-inside-owned-scope
grammar: grammar Owned { @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none @root @mapping(Value, params=[child, again]) Root ::= CAPTURE_SCOPE(CAPTURE(word, Child) @child ':' SAME_AS(word) @again); @mapping(Leaf, params=[text]) Child ::= '😀' @text; }

name: imported-token-inside-owned-scope
grammar: grammar Owned { @import letters from 'parts/letters.ubnf' @ubnf: v2 @package: ownedprobe @whitespace: none @root @mapping(Value, params=[first, again]) Root ::= CAPTURE_SCOPE(CAPTURE(word, letters.A) @first SAME_AS(word) @again); }
